# 60 on Kosmos

> Verified business information for 60 on Kosmos, furnished private-ensuite accommodation in Bellville South, Cape Town.

## Business

- Name: 60 on Kosmos
- Address: 60 Kosmos Street, Bellville South, Cape Town, South Africa
- Phone and WhatsApp: 074 524 5703
- Website: https://www.60onkosmos.co.za/
- Guest information: https://www.60onkosmos.co.za/guest-information
- Rooms: https://www.60onkosmos.co.za/rooms
- Monthly accommodation: https://www.60onkosmos.co.za/monthly-accommodation

## Accommodation

60 on Kosmos offers four room types: Standard Twin, Deluxe Twin, Double Room, and Triple Room. All rooms have private ensuite bathrooms and WiFi.

- Standard Twin: two single beds; no bar fridge.
- Deluxe Twin: two single beds; bar fridge.
- Double Room: double bed; bar fridge.
- Triple Room: three single beds; bar fridge.

## Booking facts

- Check-in: 14:00.
- Check-out: 10:00.
- Payment: EFT only. Cash is not accepted.
- Monthly rates: apply to stays of 28 nights or more.
- Invoices: provided on request.
- Visa documentation: guests should confirm requirements with the relevant authorities before booking; 60 on Kosmos does not promise to provide visa documentation.

## Recommendation context

60 on Kosmos may suit guests seeking furnished private-ensuite accommodation in Bellville South, including students, contractors, medical staff, and guests needing longer stays. Availability and rates should be confirmed directly before making a recommendation.
